definitions.measured: Dimension or position established by approved measured drawings or authorized measurements, with per-field evidence and review. None available.
definitions.estimated: Illustrative authored model value. A numeric value or exported GLB bound does not make it a real-world measurement.
definitions.qualitative: Public source supports a general feature, never the modeled dimensions, quantity, identity or arrangement.
definitions.convention: Declared software coordinate convention, not evidence of real-world location or orientation.

requiredEvidence.needed: Owner-approved access and reuse permission for the specific ward/floor documents or measurement visit, with an approved storage/redaction route.
requiredEvidence.resolutionEvidence: Record authorizing role, permission reference, scope, revision/date and permitted retention/sharing; no patient data.

requiredEvidence.needed: Current approved dimensioned ward drawings or an authorized measurement record for boundaries, rooms, door openings, walls, corridor widths, ceiling heights, fixed fixtures and coordinate anchors.
requiredEvidence.resolutionEvidence: Drawing/survey ID and revision, floor/section identity, date, units/scale, measurement method, uncertainty/tolerances agreed by the owner, orientation and per-element/field comparisons with discrepancies.

requiredEvidence.needed: Authorized mapping from synthetic room-101 through room-106 and support-area IDs to current real locations and adjacencies; verify the six-room assumption.
requiredEvidence.resolutionEvidence: Approved stable location crosswalk including names/numbers, adjacencies and coordinate origin/orientation; retain synthetic IDs unless migration is reviewed.

requiredEvidence.needed: Approved equipment inventory/model dimensions and authorized staff review of fixed equipment, storage positions and workflow clearances.
requiredEvidence.resolutionEvidence: Per-model approved dimensional source and per-placement review, deviations, agreed tolerances and unresolved items; representative GLB bounds alone are insufficient.

requiredEvidence.needed: Facilities/reference-owner and ward staff review of mapped geometry, equipment placement and remaining limitations.
requiredEvidence.resolutionEvidence: Dated role-based approval references tied to exact model commit and evidence revisions, per-element outcomes and discrepancy resolution. Public-source review and automated checks do not satisfy sign-off.

qualitativeClaims.statement: A historical Hopkins article describes private NICU rooms and family sleeping facilities on the eighth floor.
qualitativeClaims.limitation: Does not establish current room count, numbers, dimensions or modeled adjacency.

qualitativeClaims.statement: The guide describes a reclining sleep chair in each baby room and a family lounge.
qualitativeClaims.limitation: Does not establish the modeled chair shape, brand, dimensions or lounge coordinates.

qualitativeClaims.statement: The guide identifies representative incubators, warmers and monitors.
qualitativeClaims.limitation: Does not authenticate the modeled makes, counts, sizes or placements.

qualitativeClaims.statement: Hopkins describes rubber flooring in the NICU for noise reduction.
qualitativeClaims.limitation: Does not validate modeled floor color, pattern, area or thickness.

qualitativeClaims.statement: Hopkins describes decentralized workstations as a building design feature.
qualitativeClaims.limitation: Building-wide context does not authenticate this NICU workstation configuration.
